title: rechsteineria aurantiaca
intro: Rechsteineria aurantiaca, commonly known as Golden Chamomile, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, and soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rechsteineria aurantiaca include its sedative and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating restlessness and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
